query: SELECT 'won_deal' AS "kind!", pid AS "pid!", closed_at AS "at!", NULL::varchar AS purpose FROM deals WHERE primary_contact_pid = $1 AND won AND closed_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'inquiry', pid, created_at, purpose FROM form_submissions WHERE contact_pid = $1 UNION ALL SELECT 'inquiry', pid, opened_at, NULL FROM tickets WHERE contact_pid = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
